prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling interior of a vintage train dining car. In the center foreground sits a polished oak table holding a steaming porcelain teacup, a silver spoon resting beside it, and a folded linen napkin. To the left of this central arrangement, an elderly woman in a floral blouse leans forward, her hand extended toward a young boy in a blue cap who looks up at her with wide eyes. The boy holds a half-eaten apple in his small fist. Beside them, a leather satchel rests on the floor, its strap loosely coiled. On the right side of the aisle, a conductor in a navy uniform stands tall, checking a pocket watch held firmly in his gloved hand. Next to him, a sleeping tabby cat curls tightly on an empty velvet seat, its tail twitching slightly. Behind the conductor, a large window reveals a blurred landscape of green hills passing by. Further back in the car, a couple shares a quiet moment; the man in a grey suit gestures with his index finger toward a menu held by the woman in a yellow dress, who smiles softly while adjusting her glasses. A waiter in a white apron balances a tray with two crystal water glasses, walking carefully between the tables. Near the rear door, a businessman in a pinstripe suit types rapidly on a vintage typewriter placed on a small folding desk. A stack of newspapers lies discarded next to his feet. Above, a brass luggage rack holds a brown suitcase and a rolled-up umbrella. Hanging from the ceiling, a single pendant lamp casts a soft glow over the scene. At the far end, a chef in a white hat peers out from the kitchen doorway, wiping his hands on a cloth. A small potted fern sits on a sideboard near the kitchen, adding a touch of greenery. There is no digital technology visible in the scene. There is no modern plastic packaging anywhere. There is no bright sunlight streaming through the windows. The composition relies on the delicate interplay of graphite lines and subtle watercolor tints to define the space and characters without heavy shading or dramatic contrast.
